exclusions.source_text: HIV-positive patients on combination antiretroviral therapy are eligible if their HIV is under adequate control with an antiretroviral regimen that has been stable for \> 4 weeks, as long as the CD4 count is \>300.
Pregnant women or participants unwilling to adhere to institutional guidelines for highly effective contraception for 12 months after the last dose of rituximab are excluded from this study
Patients with uncontrolled hepatitis B or C or HIV infection are ineligible defined as patients with positive serologies and a detectable viral load by PCR.
symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia
Patients who had prior systemic therapy including rituximab
